title: SEED-L01 per-row outstandingLoanBalance column: a waiver does not move the balance
_note: Parity vector pinning the DERIVED per-row outstandingLoanBalance column of the SEED-L01 transactions read-back (loan-1-transactions-after-raw.json), three rows: disbursement 100000.00 (balance 100000.00); accrual 6618.53 carrying NO balance cell (the oracle leaves it absent, null, never zero); waive-interest 1000.00 whose outstandingLoanBalance is 100000.00 UNCHANGED from the disbursement, because the balance tracks principal and a waiver recognises no principal. The three request rows transcribe amount and principalPortion only; principal_minor is omitted where the capture row's principalPortion is null. No amount here was computed: 10000000 and 661853 are 100000.00 and 6618.53 in minor units, and the post-waiver balance 100000.00 is exactly the disbursement balance the capture shows on the waiver row.

provenance.note: request.transactions and expect.transaction_rows transcribe rows 1, 2 and 13 of the committed capture loan-1-transactions-after-raw.json; capture_case_id names the externalId of the observed loan.
